newsitem.title: LEBANON: Malaysians want to invest in Lebanon toll roads.
newsitem.headline: Malaysians want to invest in Lebanon toll roads.

text.p: Malaysian companies are interested in investing in toll roads and other privatised projects in Lebanon, Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said in Beirut on Wednesday.

"We are interested in quite a number of things including toll ways, different areas in development and also in other privatised projects," Mahathir told a news conference at the end of a three-day visit to Lebanon.
He was accompanied during the visit by four government ministers and representatives of Malaysia's private sector.
Last week, the Lebanese government decided to establish a $350 million private toll road company to build a motorway to Syria and ringroads around Beirut at an estimated cost of $1.2 billion.

"Our companies are looking into this and they look into the structure of the corporation that will build the toll roads in order to find out whether we would be able to participate in it or find some other way for working together," Mahathir said.
